summary: Full retest at 390x844 after AuthProvider fix. SESSION PERSISTENCE BUG IS FIXED: login writes session to localStorage (hs_admin, 352 bytes), hard reload on /home stays on /home, and deep links /cities, /pricing, /finance, /alerts, /search all render data (no 'Not authenticated'). All other requested flows PASS end-to-end. Cities: city-card tap opens city-launch-modal, pincode-chip-input-field + pincode-add-btn adds pincode, city-surge-switch + 14 city-svc-* toggles + city-json-btn + city-save-btn present and save succeeds (modal closes); open-city-launch-btn opens creation form (city-name-input + city-state-input), save adds 'TestCityQA' (3->4 cards), re-opening its card shows city-delete-btn which opens city-delete-confirm, confirming deletes it (4->3 cards, 'TestCityQA deleted' toast). Pricing: pricing-seg-surge / pricing-seg-coupons both work; 3 surge-toggle-* visible and tappable; open-surge-dialog-btn opens dialog with surge-name-input + surge-save-btn (created 'QATestSurge'); open-coupon-dialog-btn opens coupon-code-input + coupon-value-input + coupon-save-btn (created 'QATEST10'); 4 delete buttons rendered. Finance: commission-default-inc/dec/save-btn all present and 'Commission saved'; generate-settlements-btn produced 4 settlements with 4 settlement-release-* buttons (clicking one shows 'Released INR 11,009.99 to Pooja Verma' toast and badge flips to COMPLETED); settlement-invoice-* chips also wired (opens settlement-invoice-dialog sheet with 'Commission tax invoice'); finance-seg-invoices shows 40 invoice-view-* rows, tapping opens invoice-sheet with full GST breakdown (CGST/SGST/UPI). Global search admin-global-search: 'HS' returns 5 booking results (HS251262/691783/185831/612714/383051), '98000' returns 5 customers (Meera/Kabir/Sana/Rohan/Ishita with 98000000xx phones), tapping a customer navigates to /bookings?q=9800000001. Alerts: 2 alert-action-* present, clicking first shows 'Action recorded' and list shrinks to 1. Bookings: 51 rows; tapping first row opens booking-detail-sheet with reassign-btn-* -> 5 assign-* options -> 'Job (re)assigned' and status chip updates ASSIGNED; another row has admin-cancel-btn-* -> confirm-cancel-btn -> 'Cancelled & refunded' and status flips to CANCELLED. Partners KYC: 2 kyc-expand-*, expanding reveals 4 kyc-approve-* and 4 kyc-reject-*; approving Aadhaar shows 'Aadhaar approved' and badge flips PENDING->APPROVED. Logout: admin-logout-btn redirects to /login, localStorage hs_admin is cleared (null), hard reload remains on /login. settle-cod-* and payout-pay-* could NOT be exercised in this run because the seeded data currently has no partner with cod_cash > 0 and no payout with status='requested' (they are conditionally rendered, testIDs are correctly wired in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/partners.tsx lines 149 & 159). The three previously reported RN-web warnings (shadow* -> boxShadow, Animated useNativeDriver on web, charts.tsx) still fire but are non-blocking. The i18n foot-gun on login brand (Home<T>Serve</T>) is unchanged. No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch).

rca_of_issue: Fix verified: AuthProvider in /app/frontend/src/auth.tsx now (a) persists session JSON to storage key 'hs_admin' after login via storage.setItem; (b) rehydrates on mount via storage.getItem before flipping `ready=true`; (c) gates child render on `ready` so neither /cities nor (tabs) layout fires an API call before the Authorization header is restored. storage/index.web.ts uses window.localStorage, so web picks up the token on reload. Verified: localStorage['hs_admin'] length 352 after login; reload /home -> stays; deep links /cities /pricing /finance /alerts /search all load data; logout clears key to null and reload stays on /login.
